balls.text: four to finish the innings! Short and wide outside off stump. Hasaranga gives himself plenty of room and generates enough bat speed to slice it over backward point
slow and short outside off stump. Hazlewood is too early into his stroke and clogs it towards long off for just a single
slower delivery on a back of a length on middle and off stump. Hazlewood defends it stoutly back to the bowler

oh well! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Siraj shuffles across his crease and looks for the scoop first up. Seems to miss but Pooran thinks there is a nick. In fact, LSG have reviewed this one! The ball does pass close to the bat and there is indeed a slight spike as the ball is next to the gloves. Inspired review, and Naveen is now on a hat-trick!

straight to backward point! Slower delivery banged into the track outside off stump. Karn tries to upper cut it over backward point but just does not have any pace to work with. In the end, he spoons it straight to Gowtham at backward point, who makes no mistake!
full and angled into leg stump. Hasaranga has a stab at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump. Karn backs away a touch and dabs it towards backward point, where Bishnoi misfields and concedes the second
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Hasaranga heaves it away towards deep mid wicket but has to settle for the single

what a piece of work that is by Yash Thakur! Leaps into the air in delight! Slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Hasaranga cloths it back towards the bowler. Thakur gathers the ball to his left, realises that Karthik has wandered down the track and hits the stumps at the bowler's end, with Karthik well out of his ground!
low full toss on the pads. Karthik uses the pace and flicks it away towards deep backward square leg for one
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Hasaranga shimmies around before punching it down the ground for a single
dug into the track outside off stump. Hasaranga has a swish at it but only connects with the fresh Lucknow air
slower delivery on a length on middle and off stump. Hasaranga dabs it towards backward point and gets off the mark

huge appeal, and given! That looks very adjacent! Length delivery slanted into off stump. The ball skids through and keeps a little low. Lomror is late on the stroke and is pinned on the pads. The umpire raises his finger and Lomror, after a long discussion with Karthik, reviews. Looks like the ball struck the back pad and if the impact is in line (or even Umpire's Call), this could be curtains for Lomror. Umpire's Call on Impact and the ball is going on to hit the stumps. Lomror has to go!
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Karthik lets the ball come to him before running it down to short third man
slower bumper on middle and leg stump. Lomror gets inside the line of the ball and pulls it away towards deep backward square leg
short and wide outside off stump. Karthik is early into his cut and only manages to scuff it towards backward point
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Lomror comes forward and pushes it down the ground. Karthik wants the second but is sent back
full delivery on off stump. Lomror gets onto the front foot and drives it down the ground for a single

sliced and taken by Krunal at cover! Looped up nicely on a length outside off stump and du Plessis' eyes light up. He tries to go over the bowler's head but the ball spins away just enough to take a chunk off the outside edge. The ball spoons up towards cover where Krunal holds his nerve and completes the catch!
full delivery on leg stump. du Plessis backs away and drills it towards long on for a couple of runs
very full delivery on middle and leg stump. Karthik comes forward and knocks it down the ground for one
dragged down on middle and leg stump, and that is too easy for Karthik! He goes deep into his crease and mauls it over deep mid wicket!
short and outside off stump. The ball just does not arrive as du Plessis tugs it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis backs away and stabs it towards extra cover for one more run
slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Karthik waits an eternity for it before jabbing it towards backward point
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Karthik gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side
shot! Marginally short outside off stump. Karthik picks up the length early, rocks back and hammers it over mid wicket for four!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Karthik has a nibble at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
slower bumper on off stump that just does not arrive. du Plessis plays two strokes before the ball eventually arrives and he helps it round the corner
slowed up even more on a length on middle and off stump. The ball spins away as Karthik hangs back and defends into the off side
full delivery on leg stump. du Plessis gets onto the front foot and flicks it towards long on for one more run
full delivery just outside off stump. Karthik lunges forward and chips it down the ground to get off the mark

taken at long off, eventually! Back of a length delivery at the stumps. Prabhudessai shimmies around his crease, looking to create room for himself. He flat-bats it towards long off, where Gowtham misjudges it initially but then dives forward in the nick of time to gobble it up!
slower and shorter outside off stump. Prabhudessai has a wild reverse hack at it and does not make any contact
full delivery at the stumps. du Plessis gets forward and pushes it towards long on

length delivery on leg stump that sticks in the surface. Prabhudessai closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge towards backward point. The fielder fires it towards the bowler's end, where Krunal gets a hand to it but ends up deflecting it past the stumps, allowing the second
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Prabhudessai places it into the vast real estate on the leg side and dashes back for the second
full and angled into off stump. Prabhudessai tries to play the stroke Maxwell did but does not enjoy much success either. That might have hit the pad too but the impact was probably outside the line
slightly quicker on a full length on leg stump. du Plessis backs away and prods it towards extra cover for a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Prabhudessai gets onto the back foot and punches it towards long off for one
full and darted into leg stump. du Plessis tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis lets the ball come to him before working it into the leg side for a single
length delivery outside off stump. Prabhudessai has a swipe at it and gets a top edge that bobbles towards deep backward square leg

huge appeal, and given! Another slowish delivery on a length on middle and off stump. Maxwell decides to go for the reverse but plays all over it. He is pinned on the back leg and the umpire, without any hesitation, raises his finger. Maxwell wants to have another look, though! Big gap between bat and ball. Ball Tracking shows that the ball would have just clipped the top of middle stump. Umpire's Call and Maxwell has to go! Maxwell came after Bishnoi but the leg-spinner was prepared for it!
slowed up on a length on middle and off stump. Maxwell does not pick the googly until very late either and defends it eventually
back of a length delivery on the pads. du Plessis helps it round the corner and Maxwell scampers across to the other end
full and outside off stump. Maxwell plants his front foot and drills it down to long off
short and wide outside off stump. Maxwell gets onto the back foot and cuts it past extra cover. Mayers gives chase from the point fence and pulls it back in
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Maxwell goes back and glances it down to short fine leg

holes out to deep mid wicket! Dragged down outside off stump and Rawat looks to clear the shorter fence. The ball, though, just sticks in the surface enough to muddle with Rawat's timing. He shanks it and Mayers does the rest on the fence! LSG keep chipping away!
length delivery outside off stump. Rawat squirts it towards backward point, where the fielder misfields and ends up conceding two
back of a length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis works it towards deep square leg for one more run
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rawat camps deep in his crease and cuts it towards deep cover point
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rawat opens up his stance and powers it towards long off for one

just short! Full delivery just outside off stump. Rawat gets down on one knee and heaves it on the bounce to deep mid wicket. The fielder misfields and allows the batters to get back for the second. The fielder hits the stumps at the bowler's end from the deep but du Plessis has comfortably made it
length delivery on middle and off stump. Rawat goes back and pats it towards the bowler
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Rawat waits in his crease and squeezes it past backward point for a couple of runs
googly on a length just outside off stump. Rawat defends it into the off side
back of a length delivery outside off stump. du Plessis hangs back and eases it towards long on
full delivery just outside off stump. Rawat comes forward and plonks it into the off side
length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis lets the ball come to him before turning it towards deep square leg for a single
back of a length delivery at the stumps. du Plessis goes back and jabs it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rawat gets onto the back foot and punches it towards deep cover point for one
big turn! Slowed up on a length outside off stump. Rawat thinks about playing at it before seeing the ball rip past the outside edge
back of a length delivery at the stumps. du Plessis goes back and works it into the leg side for a single

Bishnoi gets Kohli! Googly on a length outside off stump. Kohli comes down the track and tries to go inside out. He does not get to the pitch of it, though, and the ball just sneaks past the flailing blade. Pooran does the rest behind the stumps and Bishnoi breaks RCB's opening stand!
full delivery outside off stump. du Plessis reaches out for it and jabs it towards deep cover point

given a bit of air on a full length on middle and leg stump. du Plessis has a stab at it and squirts the ball off the inside edge into the leg side. The batters, though, somehow manage to sneak in a brace
full delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli lunges forward and pushes it back past the bowler for a single
length delivery fired into the pads. du Plessis eases it towards deep mid wicket
full delivery just outside off stump. Kohli lunges forward and pokes it past backward point for a single
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. du Plessis dabs it towards backward point
back of a length delivery on off stump. Kohli is cramped for room and flat-bats it down the ground for a single
breaks the shackles! Full delivery outside off stump. Kohli gets onto the front foot and cracks it past extra cover for a much-needed boundary!
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Kohli leaves it alone as the umpire indulges in some more exercise. That was a tight call!
back of a length delivery outside off stump that zips through. Kohli throws his hands at it but only connects with the fresh Lucknow air
back of a length delivery on off stump. Kohli gets up on his toes and drops the ball right beside him with soft hands
slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. Kohli comes down the track and has a swipe at it. Makes no contact whatsoever
banged into the track on middle and off stump. Kohli advances and then lets it go. Called a wide by the square leg umpire for height
short and wide outside off stump. du Plessis rocks onto the back foot and cuts it powerfully past extra cover for a couple of runs
quicker and flatter on a length on off stump. Kohli goes back and pushes it towards long on for one more run
slow and short outside off stump. du Plessis hangs back and jabs it towards long off for one
length delivery at the stumps that does not bounce quite as much as expected. Kohli punches it down the ground for a single
length delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis waits in his crease and turns it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Kohli goes back and eases it down the ground for one
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Kohli stands up tall and knocks it towards long on for a single
length delivery on leg stump. Kohli lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads past square leg for a couple of runs
full delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis gets forward and drives it back past the bowler for one
full delivery just outside off stump. Kohli gets down on one knee and slogs it towards deep mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli goes back and punches it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery slanted into the pads. Kohli has a swipe at it but is too early into the stroke. Gets pinged on the thigh pad
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Kohli pats it into the leg side and hares across to the other end
back of a length delivery at the stumps. du Plessis gives himself a bit of room and punches it uppishly to long off
back of a length delivery on leg stump that holds in the surface. du Plessis goes back and stabs it towards mid on
full delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli gets forward and punches it towards long off for one more run
slowed up a touch on a length on leg stump. du Plessis backs away and turns it into the on side for another single
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Kohli presses half forward and nudges it into the leg side for one
length delivery outside off stump. Kohli pushes it into the off side and calls his captain through for the single
four more! Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Kohli advances, gets on top of the bounce and guides it past short third man
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. du Plessis taps it towards mid off for a single
clears the fence! In the slot outside off stump and du Plessis does not miss out. He picks the pace-on delivery and carves it over mid off
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. The ball just does not arrive as du Plessis tugs it towards the bowler

nearly! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. du Plessis chunks it off the inside edge into his pads and wanders down the track. Kohli then sends him back and he is saved as Naveen misses his shy from two yards out
length delivery on leg stump. du Plessis turns it into the leg side and this time, gets across for a much more comfortable single
length delivery on middle and off stump. Kohli comes forward and pushes it down the ground for another single
full and fired into leg stump. du Plessis tips it into the off side and scrambles across to the other end. A direct hit would have made things interesting!
back of a length delivery at the stumps. du Plessis tries to force it through the off side but the slowness means that he can only scuff it back to Krunal
length delivery fired into leg stump. du Plessis is late on the stroke and is rapped on the pads. Going down leg, though
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Kohli goes back and punches it down the ground towards long off
shot! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. du Plessis stands up tall and threads it between extra cover and cover point for four
safe again! Full delivery angled into leg stump. Kohli backs away and tries to flick it but gets a massive leading edge that just loops past short extra cover
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. du Plessis lets the ball come to him before tucking it away towards deep mid wicket
safe! Back of a length delivery outside off stump that shapes away late. du Plessis mistimes his swipe and the ball agonisingly evades Naveen, who is backtracking from mid on
short outside off stump. The ball holds in the surface just a tad but du Plessis manages to short-arm jab it past mid wicket for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Kohli takes a step down the track and works it past short mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump that sticks in the surface. du Plessis goes back and plonks it towards mid on
length delivery outside off stump. Kohli comes onto the front foot and knocks it down the ground for a single
full delivery on leg stump. Kohli lunges forward and flicks it towards square leg. He wants the single but du Plessis is not interested
length delivery fired into leg stump. Kohli plays all over it as the ball thuds into the thigh pad
length delivery just outside off stump. Kohli comes half forward and defends into the off side
big turn! Length delivery outside off stump that spins away sharply and bounces a tad extra. Kohli has a stab at it and gets a thick outside edge that races away past short third man

that will be that! RCB win by 18 runs! Slower delivery on a length on leg stump. Mishra is at least a week early into his attempted lofted stroke and somehow skews it towards the keeper. Karthik settles under it and completes the catch, handing RCB their fifth win this season!
dug into the track on leg stump. Mishra backs away and slaps it towards deep point. No run taken again!
gets it away for four! Low full toss at the stumps. Mishra walks across his stumps very early and laps it nicely over short fine leg
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Mishra takes a step down the track and flat-bats it towards long off. Rahul thinks about walking down to the other end before deciding against it
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Mishra has a hack at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
short and wide outside off stump. Rahul hits it straight to the fielder at cover point. No run, and Mishra will be on strike for the final over

full and wide outside off stump. Rahul leaves it alone and the umpire decides to indulge in a bit of exercise. RCB have reviewed this, though! But hang on, before all of that happens, this has been called a No ball! Oh my, drama at Lucknow!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rahul sits deep in his crease and hacks it towards deep mid wicket

edged and taken! Dug into the track outside off stump. Naveen tries to use the pace and ramp it over the keeper's head. He gets bat on it but only manages a very faint tickle that Karthik snaps up with the minimal of fuss!
how has he gotten that there?! Very full delivery outside off stump. Naveen looks for the reverse lap and somehow, off the toe-end of the bat, gets it past short fine leg for four!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Naveen sits deep in his crease and slices it over extra cover for a couple of runs
short and outside off stump. Mishra comes down the track and chips it towards deep point for just another single
slower delivery on a back of a length on off stump. Mishra waits in his crease and punches it towards deep point for a single
yorker slanted into the pads. Naveen digs it out and Mishra is alert enough to scamper across to the other end
shot! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Naveen marches down the track, gets on top of the bounce and crunches it over extra cover for four! Almost cleared the fence there!
full toss on middle and leg stump. Mishra tugs it away towards deep backward square leg for just a single
very full delivery outside off stump. Naveen shuffles across and misses his flick. The ball, though, deflects off his toe into the off side for a leg bye
slower yorker outside off stump. Mishra dangles his bat and chips it towards extra cover for a single

full and fired into the pads. Naveen does not get bat on it as the ball squirts off the inside edge towards the keeper. Siraj gives Naveen a bit of a stare-down and then throws the ball into the stumps at the batter's end

short and down the leg side. Naveen ducks underneath it and this time, the square leg umpire calls it a No ball because this is the second bouncer above the batter's shoulder. RCB, though, have reviewed this! But the call stands. Free hit coming up for Naveen!
length delivery outside off stump. Naveen takes a step down the track and pats it into the off side
banged into the track on leg stump. Naveen ducks underneath it and then sees the square leg umpire call it a wide for height

full delivery on middle adn leg stump. Mishra flicks it towards mid wicket and sets off for the single. The fielder picks it up cleanly and fires it at the bowler's end. Kohli takes off the bails but Mishra has made his ground by then
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Mishra looks to work to leg but plays all over it as the ball pings into the thigh pad
edged and four! Short and wide outside off stump. Mishra throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies down to third man. Harshal puts in the dive but lets it go through
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump that skids through. Naveen stabs at it and misses. The keeper fumbles too, and allows a bye
googly on a length on off stump. Mishra swipes at it and misses as the ball hits him on the body
another googly on a back of a length on middle and leg stump. Mishra dabs it down to short third man
googly on a length just outside off stump. Mishra goes back and pokes it towards the bowler
length delivery outside off stump. Mishra comes down the track and prods it back to the bowler via a combination of bat and pad
very full delivery on middle and leg stump. Mishra tries the reverse sweep and just about gets some bat on it
full delivery on middle and off stump. Naveen gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg
length delivery fired into the track on middle and off stump. Naveen comes half forward and prods it past extra cover for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Naveen goes back and defends into the off side

dropped! But Bishnoi has run himself out, this is just crazy cricket! Length delivery outside off stump. Bishnoi reverse-sweeps it hard towards backward point, where Hazlewood puts it down. Bishnoi then, for some reason, thinks the second is on and despite the dive, is at least a yard short of his ground!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Bishnoi swings too hard and scuffs it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Mishra advances and cuts it towards extra cover, where Kohli misfields and concedes the single
full delivery outside off stump. Bishnoi plants his front foot and drags it towards long on for a single
short delivery on leg stump. Bishnoi gets up on his toes and helps it towards deep square leg
full delivery on off stump. Mishra wants to go downtown but is so early into his stroke that he shanks it towards deep mid wicket for one
slower bumper outside off stump. Bishnoi tries to get out of the way but dangles his bat like a periscope. The ball pings off the toe end and bobbles down to third man
dug into the track on off stump. Mishra gets onto the back foot and pulls it away towards fine leg. Just a single, though
length delivery just outside off stump. Mishra comes half forward and defends into the off side
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Mishra dabs it straight to backward point
full delivery on leg stump. Mishra gets down on one knee and heaves it towards deep backward square leg
length delivery on middle and off stump. Mishra jabs it towards short extra cover
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Mishra goes back and taps it towards short mid wicket
ouch! Tossed up on a length outside off stump. Mishra tries the funky scoop but gets no bat on it. Cops a blow on the body for his troubles
length delivery on leg stump. Mishra lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
full delivery on middle and off stump. Mishra gets onto the front foot and blocks it back to the bowler
off-pace delivery on a length on off stump that grips in the surface. Bishnoi nearly pops it straight to the fielder at short mid wicket
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Bishnoi comes forward and drops it right beside him with very soft hands
full delivery at the stumps. Mishra comes half forward and flicks it down the ground, just past short mid wicket for a single
slower delivery on a full length on leg stump. Bishnoi closes his bat face too early and gets a leading edge towards deep point
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Mishra gets up on his toes and runs it down to third man to get off the mark

oh dear! LSG are finding new ways to get out now! Back of a length delivery on off stump. Gowtham dabs it towards deep backward point and scampers back for the second. The throw is accurate enough and Karthik takes off the bails at the batter's end but has Gowtham made his ground by then? No he has not! Gowtham's arm was not as extended as it should have been and he has to now walk back!
full delivery just outside off stump. Bishnoi gets a massive stride forward and blocks it into the off side
full delivery on middle and off stump. Bishnoi lunges forward and pokes it back to the bowler

Stoinis perishes! LSG are imploding here! Flighted on a length outside off stump. Stoinis looks to go inside out but is nowhere close to the pitch of the ball. Slices it a mile in the air and Prabhudessai does the rest at long off!
is that a drop? Flighted on a full length outside off stump. Gowtham has a massive swish at it and gets a bottom edge that is grassed by Karthik. Tough chance, though
length delivery on leg stump. Stoinis does not seem to get bat on it as the ball pings off the thigh pad into the on side
full delivery on leg stump. Stoinis comes forward and defends into the on side
googly on a length on off stump. Gowtham lets the ball come to him before dabbing it towards backward point
Gowtham goes big again! Tossed up into the slot outside off stump. Gowtham reaches out for it and batters it over the bowler's head!
length delivery on off stump. Stoinis waits in his crease and punches it back past the bowler for a single
full delivery just outside off stump. Gowtham lunges forward and nudges it into the off side for one more run
flighted on a full length outside off stump. Stoinis plants his front foot and drills it down the ground towards long off
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Gowtham goes back and dabs it towards deep cover point for one
length delivery on middle and off stump. Gowtham presses half forward and nurdles it into the off side for a single
oh! Length delivery on off stump that grips and spins away sharply. Gowtham has a nibble at it and is beaten all ends up
short and outside off again. Stoinis hangs back in his crease and cuts it towards deep point for one more run
short and wide outside off stump. Gowtham gets back and jabs it towards deep point for a single
four more! Full delivery fired into leg stump. Gowtham gets inside the line of the ball just enough and tickles it fine past the keeper
shot! Dragged down on leg stump. Gowtham picks the length early, rocks back and whips it away over the deep square leg fence!
full delivery on middle and off stump. Stoinis gets forward and pokes it towards extra cover
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Stoinis taps it towards short mid wicket
googly on a back of a length on leg stump. Gowtham goes back and hoicks it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
full delivery just outside off stump. Gowtham gets forward and defends it back to the bowler
tossed up on a full length outside off stump. Stoinis lunges forward and drives it crisply towards long off for a single
full delivery on off stump. Stoinis has a waft at it and gets a thick outside edge down to short third man

taken at deep square leg! Pooran goes! Full delivery outside leg stump and Pooran tries to hit that into next week. The ball, though, just holds in the surface a little and he gets it right off the toe end of the bat. The ball goes miles up into the air and when it comes down, Lomror does the rest on the fence!
length delivery on leg stump. Pooran tries to work to leg but plays all over it as the ball pings into the thigh pad
back of a length delivery on leg stump that skids through. Stoinis tugs it away towards deep mid wicket for one
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Pooran lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads towards deep square leg
back of a length delivery at the stump. Stoinis punches it down the ground and canters across to the other end
short and outside off stump. Pooran goes back and hacks it towards long on for a single
another googly on a full length on middle and leg stump. Stoinis lunges forward and defends into the on side
googly on a length on middle and off stump. Stoinis picks the googly off the surface and prods it towards short mid wicket
back of a length delivery on off stump. Pooran gets onto the back foot and heaves it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Pooran waits in his crease and swings it away towards short fine leg
oh, hello! Oh, hello! In the slot on middle and leg stump. Pooran wonders what the fuss is about, plants his front foot and whacks it over wide long on!

appeal for a stumping! Googly tossed up nicely on a length just outside off stump. Hooda goes searching for it and plays all over it as the ball snakes past the inside edge. Karthik whips off the bails in a flash but has Hooda dragged his back foot out of his crease? We go through the entire protocol of checking whether there is a nick. No bat involved but Hooda's back foot is on the crease when Karthik takes off the bails! LSG are in disarray, and RCB, at this stage, can do no wrong!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Stoinis hangs back and stabs it towards the fielder at cover point
right out of the screws! In the slot on off stump and Stoinis does not miss out! He plants his front foot, swings through the line and pumps it over the bowler's head!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Stoinis has a swish at it but can only scuff it towards mid off
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Stoinis gets onto the back foot and taps it towards short extra cover
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Stoinis stands tall and jabs it towards Kohli at short extra cover

Badoni bites the dust too! RCB are all over LSG! In the slot outside off stump and Badoni's eyes light up. He tries to go inside out but does not quite get the elevation he is after. Hits it in the air in the extra cover region and Kohli does the rest, leaping up into the air and snaffling it!
length delivery down the leg side. Badoni goes back and turns it towards short fine leg for one more run
very full delivery outside off stump. Badoni waits for it and drives it towards point, where Siraj pulls out the dive and saves a certain boundary
length delivery on the pads. Hooda comes forward and works it into the leg side to get off the mark

Krunal bites the dust! Given just a bit of air on a length outside off stump. Krunal comes down the track and is not to the pitch of the ball. In the end, all he does is chip it straight to Kohli at long off, who makes no mistake! LSG in a spot of bother now!
length delivery on off stump. Krunal gets down on one knee and tugs it towards backward square leg
back of a length delivery outside leg stump. Badoni goes back and helps it behind square on the leg side for one
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Krunal advances and jabs it towards cover. He wants the single but is sent back by Badoni
short and wide outside off stump. Krunal tries to upper cut it but misses. Called a wide for height, though. Siraj wants to review it but does not find much support from his skipper
best of the lot! Slower delivery that lands right in the slot on middle and off stump. Krunal plants his front foot and thumps it over the bowler's head
four more! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Krunal gives himself plenty of room and muscles it over mid off
shot! Fractionally short on middle and leg stump. Krunal picks the length very early and dumps it over mid wicket for a much-needed boundary!
back fo a length delivery outside off stump. Krunal punches it towards mid off, where Rawat gives chase and misfields, allowing the second
back of a length delivery on off stump. Badoni tips it down the ground and saunters across to the other end
full delivery angled into middle and off stump. Badoni comes onto the front foot and nudges it into the on side to get off the mark
short and wide outside off stump. Badoni has another swish at it and does not get anywhere close to the ball
length delivery just outside off stump. Badoni plants his front foot and hacks it in ugly fashion towards mid on
back of a length delivery on off stump. Badoni gets up on his toes and defends it towards mid wicket
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Badoni wafts at it for the second ball running and is beaten again
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that climbs through. Badoni has a fish at it but is beaten all ends up
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Krunal gets onto the back foot and pokes it back to the bowler
short and wide outside off stump. Krunal has a wild swipe at it and misses it by quite some distance. The ball ends up at first slip but the umpire does not call it a wide
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Krunal gets up on his toes and taps it into the off side
back of a length delivery that slides down the leg side. Krunal does not get bat on it as the umpire indulges in a bit of exercise
length delivery outside off stump. Krunal has a waft at it and gets a thick inside edge that dribbles towards the bowler

Siraj gets Mayers! Oh my! Back of a length delivery on off stump that seems to hurry onto Mayers. He has a swipe at it but splices it badly. The ball lobs up towards mid on, where Rawat does the rest! Massive, massive moment in the game!
full delivery just outside off stump. Mayers throws his hands at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards the bowler
